purpose: RQ1 protocol v3 opportunity-gate development evaluation; recorded before every real v3 call, including smoke and fixtures
git_head_meaning: Base HEAD at record creation, not the later commit containing this record; exact proposed file contents are frozen below
disclosure: v3 was designed after inspecting the six v2 false-missed errors on Main 1. All v3 Main 1 results are development results, reported alongside v2 and never replacing it. No held-out efficacy claim is permitted before a new independently human-labeled Main 2 evaluation.
decided_by: Yuan Tian, explicit selection of option (a) in the handoff session before any v3 real-model call
unchanged_from_v2: primary agreement/FMR definitions and item-bootstrap method

primary_decision_rule.rule: Use the valid raw v3 annotation. Keep all valid numeric labels and N/A as emitted; no confidence filtering or voting in the primary result. Invalid outputs remain failed.

ablation: qwen35-9b (all three seeds reported regardless of performance; seed 329 designated primary within this model)

execution.observed_driver: 610.43.02 (jagupard38, initial nvidia-smi; runtime CUDA check still required)
execution.environment_record: Retain pip freeze and CUDA test output from setup before inference; exact transitive dependency versions may differ from FarmShare and will be disclosed
execution.concurrency: Three separate seed runs share one model server for fixtures/Main 1; each has its own journal and output directory
execution.inference_gate: Preregistration must be committed and pushed, with user authorization, before smoke or any other v3 inference

run_plan.smoke: Each model, seed 329: four existing synthetic items plus the unchanged generated long synthetic item (five outcomes per model). Check startup, latency, long context and validity; a recorded contract failure is not silently repaired.
run_plan.fixtures: Each model, seeds 329/330/331: 13 fixed synthetic fixtures; evaluate against synthetic-fixture reference. These are not human accuracy evidence.
run_plan.main1: Each model, seeds 329/330/331: all 60 frozen Main 1 items, no selection or replacement based on results

same_hardware_control.purpose: Compare v2/v3 on the same SC GPU type/runtime and describe differences from historical v2. This single rerun does not isolate hardware from concurrent-batching/randomness or dependency differences.

references: B (59 labels; M1-053 missing, not N/A)
primary_metrics: FMR = valid predicted 0 with nonzero/N/A reference / valid predictions with nonzero/N/A reference
analysis.report_counts: Always show FMR numerator/denominator, coverage numerator/denominator, failed and pending counts
analysis.intervals: 95% percentile item bootstrap, 10000 resamples; same analysis seeds/method as v2; ignores participant clustering
secondary: Seeds 330 and 331 separately; per-behavior agreement and A/B-agreed vs A/B-disagreed subsets (descriptive)
Option (b): majority of seeds 329/330/331 only on items valid in all three runs; three-way ties use 329; report its own coverage
Option (c): on valid seed-329 outputs only, keep a 0 only at high confidence, otherwise derive N/A; preserve nonzero labels and original journals; no failed item receives a derived label
analysis.failure_policy: Invalid or truncated model responses stay failed. No repair, resampling, manual journal edit or conversion of failures to N/A. All v3 failures are excluded from both primary and secondary scoring; no legacy quote-only re-scoring.
analysis.historical_reporting: Preserve and report existing v2 alongside v3, plus the new v2-SC control separately. FMR decreases must be interpreted together with coverage changes; do not claim improvement from dropped failures alone.
analysis.reporting_gate: Generate the v3 report only after all three seed runs per model have terminal outcomes for every item; recorded failures count as outcomes, not valid predictions

incidents_and_deviations: Historical v1/v2 ran on FarmShare L40S; all v3 runs are planned on SC RTX 6000 Ada.
SC install is performed offline inside a Slurm allocation; dependency/model downloads run on scdt. Actual user storage capacity is 200 GB.

For preemption/time-limit interruption, retain job IDs, Slurm state/restart count and timestamps. Resume only pending work with identical frozen inputs; never retry a recorded failed outcome. Remove a stale lock only after its owning job is confirmed finished.
Any change to the finalized v3 prompt/contract requires separately reported v4, not retuning v3 on Main 1.
held_out_boundary: Main 2 sampling rules and seed must be frozen before sampling. Agent prepares materials only; two humans label independently under v0.2 and adjudicate. No model prelabels. Main 2 FMR will not be pooled with opportunity-sparse Main 1. RQ2 remains on v2 until the held-out decision.
